description: Menivor original narrator characters (M2.3). Art is drawn procedurally by app/domains/characters/narrator_art.py from the 'look' block (free generation, no paid model). sheets.lock.json locks each character's reference sheet hash and <id>/sheet.png is the contact sheet for review; tests/reelforge/test_m2_3_narrators.py fails if the art drifts. art_status stays 'pending_owner_approval' until the owner approves the art and names (O9).

characters.name: Pip Marlow
characters.personality: Curious and upbeat. Asks the question the viewer is thinking, then answers it fast.

characters.name: Otto Quill
characters.personality: Dry, calm explainer. Short sentences, one fact at a time, a small smile at the end.

characters.name: Mira Fennick
characters.personality: Warm storyteller. Sets the scene, builds to a twist, lands the ending.

characters.name: Rook Ambry
characters.personality: Deadpan skeptic. Tests every claim out loud before he believes it.

characters.name: Tansy Vale
characters.personality: Fast and funny. Lists, countdowns and quick comparisons.

characters.name: Cato Plume
characters.personality: Gentle mentor. Explains how things work with everyday comparisons.

characters.name: Wren Oakhurst
characters.personality: Bright field reporter. Describes what she sees as if she is on location.

characters.name: Bex Tallow
characters.personality: Blunt coach. Tells you the mistake, then the fix, no filler.
